\caption{\bt{Accuracy (\%) of the user agent by data change, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, five independent runs per method (\ScenCells\ runs, \ScenValidTasks\ scored tasks, \ScenAgentHours\ agent-hours). The legend groups the methods by role: no memory is the lower bound, agents exploring alone; example retrieval (agent memory in the style of AgentSM) and invalidation on schema change (the safeguard of metric layers) are the existing ways to share, which do not check what they serve; invalidating on every write relearns after each write; \system\ maintains. Bars pool the runs; lines are 95\% bootstrap intervals over runs; a hatched bar marks a setting in which at least 25\% of the tasks used a stale definition, i.e., one whose canonical SQL answers that setting's questions incorrectly. Shaded groups pool the settings of their class. The covered breaks target key uniqueness (status rows, restated sales, duplicate load), join cardinality (SCD Type 2), and date-key completeness (date-key format). The full recheck per definition, \system\ without check-result reuse, answers within a point of \system\ on every setting and appears in Figure~\ref{fig:cost}; the self-verification variant of example retrieval and the two \system\ regression variants are reported in the text.}{按数据变化划分的用户端智能体正确率（\%），DeepSeek V4.1 Flash，每种方法 5 次独立运行（共 \ScenCells\ 次运行、\ScenValidTasks\ 道计分题、\ScenAgentHours\ 智能体小时）。图例按角色分组：无记忆是下界，智能体各自探索；示例检索（AgentSM 式的智能体记忆）与模式变更时失效（指标层的保护手段）是现有的共享方式，不检查所提供的内容；每次写入即失效在每次写入后重新学习；\system\ 做维护。柱为 5 次运行合并的正确率，竖线为按运行重抽样的 95\% 区间；斜线表示该情形下至少 25\% 的题使用了过期定义，即其规范 SQL 在该情形下答错的定义。底色组把同类情形合并。条件覆盖的破坏分别针对键唯一性（状态流水、更正保留旧行、重复加载）、连接基数（缓慢变化维）和日期键完整性（日期键格式）。整定义重查即去掉检查结果复用的 \system，在每种情形下与 \system\ 相差不到一个百分点，见图~\ref{fig:cost}；示例检索的自行核验变体与 \system\ 的两个回归测试变体在正文中报告。}}
\label{fig:scenarios}
\Description{A grouped bar chart with ten groups of five bars and a legend across the top in three titled blocks: no shared memory (no memory: agents explore alone); shared, not maintained, the existing approaches (example retrieval, agent memory in the style of AgentSM; invalidate on schema change, the metric-layer safeguard); shared and maintained (invalidate on every write, which relearns after each write; MAVRA, ours, in bold blue); and a hatched swatch for a stale definition in at least 25 percent of tasks. Groups, in three classes bracketed under the axis: held-out and the four benign updates pooled (no change, benign updates); status rows, restated sales, duplicate load, SCD Type 2, date-key format, and all covered breaks pooled (breaks covered by a condition); unit change and backup copy (outside the guarantee). Every sharing method reaches 98 to 100 percent on held-out questions and 93 to 98 on benign updates, no memory 58 and 49. Under status rows MAVRA and every write answer 100, example retrieval 64 and schema change 62 with the schema-change bar hatched; under restated sales MAVRA 100, every write 89, schema change 85 hatched, example retrieval 83; under duplicate loads MAVRA 52, schema change 40 hatched, example retrieval 35, every write 21; under SCD Type 2 all sharing methods 100, schema change hatched; under the date-key format all methods between 7 and 13. Over all covered breaks, with the values printed above the bars: no memory 32, example retrieval 59, schema change 60, every write 65, MAVRA 72 with interval 70 to 73. Unit change 27 to 49 with hatched bars for every method that keeps definitions across writes; backup copy 46 to 74, schema change highest among the sharing methods and hatched, MAVRA 56.}
